title: Yesterday’s News: Benchmarking Multi-Dimensional Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Misinformation Detection Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating misinformation detection performance (e.g., accuracy, MCC) and comparing False Positive and False Negative error rates on news articles across publishers with different political alignments (Left, Center, Right) to identify whether models disproportionately misclassify or discriminate against specific political groups.

Using a binomial logistic regression on publisher-level accuracy that includes a variable indicating whether a publisher is foreign or US-based, in order to determine if geographic origin impacts a model's ability to accurately detect misinformation.
